review: B02 G1 initial read-only implementation review

findings.evidence: 001_initial.sql grants operator_role INSERT on profile_eligibility without column restrictions; the table accepts both mock and real mode. Its authority_id=current_user constraint audits the connected role but does not itself distinguish approved corporate authority. B02-IDENTITY.md says mock grant is the only local operator grant command and that real eligibility cannot be created or activated without an approved corporate authority connection.
findings.question: Does possession of the configured operator database credential itself represent that approved authority, or must G1 enforce mock-only issuance until a separately authorized real-grant path exists?

findings.initial_observation: An earlier reviewed revision did not reject replication-capable roles and only checked outgoing role memberships.
findings.current_evidence: migrate.py queries rolreplication and rejects pg_auth_members rows where the configured role is either member or roleid.

findings.initial_observation: An earlier reviewed revision gave operator_role broad table SELECT access, including private authentication/request tables.
findings.current_evidence: 001_initial.sql now grants operator SELECT only on the stated project, authority, profile, job, artifact, and workspace tables; it excludes login transactions, sessions, commands, and outbox.

review_notes.migration: apply_migrations uses one transaction and transaction-scoped advisory lock; verifies role separation/properties and schema owner; stores per-version SQL SHA-256 and role names; rejects unknown applied versions, source drift, and role drift; errors are fixed codes and CLI output excludes DSN and role values. DDL and migration ledger writes share the transaction, so failure rolls back together.
review_notes.privileges: The runtime receives no job/command/outbox advancement or snapshot mutation privileges. It receives UPDATE(lock_version) on memberships and authorization_guards, which is narrowly needed for SELECT FOR UPDATE serialization; eligibility reads remain SELECT-only to runtime. Operator mutations are separately granted and authority-changing triggers lock the project guard. The PostgreSQL role is an application service role, not per-user project isolation; this review makes no RLS claim.
review_notes.scope: This is an initial G1 review only. It does not assert B02 acceptance or completion. TC-owned real PostgreSQL cases were reported as in progress; they were not run by this reviewer.

verification.performed: Read-only source inspection and SHA-256 pinning of listed files.
